data.spiritual_meaning: Nil expresses “Neutral, neither”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nil total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: נִיל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name that signifies emptiness or voidness in various contexts in the Hebrew Bible.

in_greek.name: Νίλος
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'nilos' meaning 'river' or 'emptying', likely named after the ancient Egyptian god Nile, whose name meant 'river' as well.

in_latin.name: Nilus
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin adaptation of the Greek name Νίλος, preserving the original Greek meaning.
